record.name: Argentina
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. The executive's June 2026 bill promotes AI and commits not to regulate prematurely.

next_check.reason: Routine yearly re-check of a state where an institute is plausible (in Europe, the G20 or the OECD, or a signatory of the Bletchley Declaration).

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. Recorded English and national or official-language queries and retrieved primary governance evidence support medium confidence. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

News search from 17 October 2026 in English and Spanish, with the Secretariat of Innovation, Science and Technology's news listing (newest 6 November). No qualifying item was found. Public-service AI adoption, general cooperation releases and an undated university programme page do not establish a national evaluator or safety access agreement. No full audit of the underlying legislation was made. Partial check, not a full record re-check.

searches.query: Argentina instituto seguridad inteligencia artificial gobierno estrategia 2026

check.language_note: The recorded es query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: AR-search = searches 1, 2 (en, es). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Different public acts covered by two publishers do not establish sufficiently independent institutional corroboration in the retrieved evidence. Confidence was low under that rule; none_identified is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.
check.governance_note: SIGEN's official guidance describes internal controls for AI implementation across the national public sector, a substantive governance framework rather than a testing institute.

record.notes:
The bill text was not read directly; the earlier bill account is secondary.

SIGEN issued an AI controls guide for public-sector internal oversight. Searches covered indexed public English and Spanish sources for a government-designated AI safety institute with a remit to evaluate advanced models.
